messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — Azure partner sent an ASN that 3 pallets labelled for our Dedicated commit (commit ID: DED-4821) got split across two manifests. Shows 22 vs 18 GPUs. :eyes:
Tom Nguyen: Ugh. That could drop us below committed units for APAC Dedicated this month if the delayed pallet doesn't clear customs. Is it a shipping split or miscount?
Sofia Martinez: Partner says one manifest (ASN-77234) is stuck at customs inspection, the other cleared. They updated ETA for the stuck manifest to 3 business days. They also offered to reassign available racks to marketplace orders unless we put a hold.
Priya Shah: We need to avoid any marketplace reassign — dedicated commits must come first. @Raj Patel can you confirm whether we can accept a partial delivery and start onboarding with 22 units?
Raj Patel: We can provision 22 immediately, but our autoscaler and allocation tables expect 40 for this Dedicated pool. If partner reallocates the remaining 18 to marketplace, some Dedicated customers could get throttled. Recommend issuing a hold and asking for reroute.
Sofia Martinez: Partner says reroute needs a signed amendment; they're asking us to cover expedited freight for reroute. Quote: $9.2k one-time.
Tom Nguyen: Do we have spend authority for that kind of expedited shipping without legal/finance signoff?
Priya Shah: Not without Finance. Need quick cost-benefit: cost of expedited vs potential SLA credits + churn risk.
Raj Patel: Quick back-of-envelope: one large Dedicated customer's SLA credits + churn risk ~ $32k/month if we can't meet commit. So $9.2k expedite seems favorable.
Sofia Martinez: I'll push partner to confirm a formal written hold and to provide manifest proof. Logging reservation IDs now:
```
reserved_commit: DED-4821
manifest_a: ASN-77233 (22 GPUs)
manifest_b: ASN-77234 (18 GPUs)
```
Priya Shah: Someone ping Finance and Tom for signoff on the expedite. Also flag Marketplace channel to pause any automatic reassigns. :pray:
Tom Nguyen: Pinged Finance (cc @Priya). Also starting an internal hold: disabling auto-reassign in the allocation service for DED-4821.
LogisticsBot: Update: ASN-77234 ETA revised to 2026-03-18 21:00 UTC. Status: customs review. :truck:
Priya Shah: OK — until Finance responds, place a formal hold with the partner and ask for written confirmation that they will not reassign manifest_b to marketplace.
Sofia Martinez: On it. I'll get the partner to email confirmation and will paste into this thread once received.
Raj Patel: Also propose we add a short-runbook for split-manifest events: priority order = Dedicated > Reserved Marketplace > Open, expedite threshold = $10k, triage owner = Partnerships. I'll draft and share. :memo:
Tom Nguyen: Agreed. Also adding a monitoring alert for Dedicated pool imbalance so we catch splits earlier.
Priya Shah: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here and forward the partner email when you have it. :thumbsup:
